decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The premises shall be used for a sushi and sashimi restaurant and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class A3 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for restaurant (A3) purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times:1100 to 2200 hours Monday - Saturday and1200 to 2100 hours Sunday, Public and Bank Holidays.All customers shall have left the premises no later than 30minutes after the closing times listed above.
Condition : 4 - Details and particulars of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sounds shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Change of use from A1 (retail) to A3 (Restaurant) with new shopfront and awning.
